name: Marshall Islands — citizenship by registration on Marshallese descent
origin_test: Marshallese descent (membership of the Marshallese people), with a discretionary interests-of-justice condition
instrument: Constitution of the Republic of the Marshall Islands
quote_original: that he is of Marshallese descent, and that in the interests of justice his application should be granted.
basis: Constitution of the Republic of the Marshall Islands, Article XI (Citizenship), Section 2 (Persons Who May Be Registered as Citizens), paragraph (1)(c)
notes: Sourced from the Nitijela's own published PDF of the Constitution on rmiparliament.org. The Nitijela also serves the Constitution as an HTML article (/cms/?view=article&id=134:the-constitution&catid=87&showall=1) and that page contains the same words, but the Joomla page routes on that host intermittently return 403 to non-browser clients while the /cms/images/LEGISLATION/ PDFs always serve, so the PDF is the stable citation. The Constitution closes no generational list: 'of Marshallese descent' is unqualified, so neither unlimited nor a maximum degree is asserted. Registration is on application to the High Court, subject to an oath of allegiance (Art. XI s.2(2)) and to Nitijela disqualification powers (s.2(3)). The Citizenship Act 1984 (43 MIRC Ch.4, https://rmiparliament.org/cms/images/LEGISLATION/PRINCIPAL/1984/1984-0004/1984-0004_1.pdf) governs naturalisation and registration in other cases and contains no descent limb at all — the word 'descent' does not appear in it. The descent route is therefore constitutional only. Note the sibling limb in s.2(1)(a), 'that he has land rights', which is itself a customary-tenure proxy for Marshallese belonging.

name: Papua New Guinea — automatic citizenship on Independence Day via two grandparents born in the country
origin_test: Two grandparents born in Papua New Guinea or an adjacent area (birthplace of ancestors, not group membership)
instrument: Constitution of the Independent State of Papua New Guinea
quote_original: A person born in the country before Independence Day who has two grand-parents who were born in the country or an adjacent area is a citizen.
basis: Constitution of the Independent State of Papua New Guinea, Part IV (Citizenship), Division 2, Section 65(1)
notes: Recorded because it is commonly cited as an indigenous-group test. It is not: the consolidated text published by the National Parliament of PNG states a BIRTHPLACE test for the two grandparents ('born in the country or an adjacent area'), with 'adjacent area' defined in s.65(3) as pre-Independence Solomon Islands, Irian Jaya and the annexed Torres Strait islands. No 'group, tribe or line indigenous to the country' wording appears anywhere in this text. origin_based is therefore false. The ceiling of two grandparents is stated on the face of the provision. s.65 is spent as an acquisition route (Independence Day, 16 September 1975); s.66 (citizenship by descent) is a one-parent rule.

name: Finland — continuous residence permit for persons originating from the former Soviet Union (Ingrian transferred population; Finnish army service 1939-45)
origin_test: Having belonged to the Ingrian (Inkeri) population transferred to Finland in 1943-44 and returned to the Soviet Union, or having served in the Finnish army in 1939-45
instrument: Ulkomaalaislaki 301/2004 (Aliens Act), consolidated
quote_original: Sen lisäksi, mitä tässä laissa muutoin säädetään, myönnetään jatkuva oleskelulupa entisen Neuvostoliiton alueelta peräisin olevalle henkilölle: 1) jos hakija on kuulunut Inkerin siirtoväkeen, joka vuosina 1943 ja 1944 siirrettiin Suomeen ja sodan päätyttyä palautettiin Neuvostoliittoon; tai 2) jos hakija on palvellut Suomen armeijassa vuosien 1939–1945 aikana.
quote_translation: In addition to what is otherwise provided in this Act, a continuous residence permit shall be granted to a person originating from the territory of the former Soviet Union: (1) if the applicant belonged to the Ingrian transferred population which was moved to Finland in 1943 and 1944 and returned to the Soviet Union after the end of the war; or (2) if the applicant served in the Finnish army during 1939-1945.
basis: Ulkomaalaislaki 301/2004, 4 luku, 48 § (Oleskeluluvan myöntäminen entisen Neuvostoliiton alueelta peräisin olevalle henkilölle), 1 momentti, as substituted by L 21.1.2011/57
notes: Sourced from the Ministry of Justice / Oikeusrekisterikeskus open-data service opendata.finlex.fi, which serves the consolidated Act as Akoma Ntoso XML. The www.finlex.fi web UI cannot be used as a source: its text is delivered only inside Next.js <script> payloads, so it does not survive tag-stripping. This is what is LEFT of the Ingrian route: the personal-status limbs survive with no time limit, while the descent-based remigration limb was closed (see the separate closed-programme row). Additional conditions: accommodation in Finland (48.2); the permit extends to family members and dependent minor children (48.3); no income requirement (48.4).

name: Finland — Ingrian Finn (inkerinsuomalaiset) remigration route, CLOSED to applications lodged after 1 July 2016
origin_test: Person originating from the former Soviet Union who, or one of whose parents, or at least two of whose four grandparents, is or was recorded in a document as being Finnish by nationality, plus sufficient Finnish or Swedish
instrument: Laki ulkomaalaislain 48 §:n muuttamisesta 57/2011 / Lag om ändring av 48 § i utlänningslagen 57/2011
quote_original: Om en person som kommer från det forna Sovjetunionens territorium själv, den ena av hans eller hennes föräldrar eller minst två av fyra mor- eller farföräldrar enligt anteckning i något dokument har eller har haft finsk nationalitet och personen i fråga har tillräckliga kunskaper i finska eller svenska, tillämpas på denna person de bestämmelser som gällde vid denna lags ikraftträdande, om sökanden har anmält sig som återflyttare vid en finsk beskickning senast den 1 juli 2011 och har lämnat in en ansökan om uppehållstillstånd senast den 1 juli 2016.
quote_translation: If a person originating from the territory of the former Soviet Union themselves, one of their parents, or at least two of their four grandparents is or has been recorded in a document as being of Finnish nationality, and that person has sufficient knowledge of Finnish or Swedish, the provisions in force at the entry into force of this Act shall apply to that person, provided that the applicant registered as a returnee with a Finnish mission by 1 July 2011 at the latest and lodged an application for a residence permit by 1 July 2016 at the latest.
basis: Laki ulkomaalaislain 48 §:n muuttamisesta 57/2011, voimaantulo- ja siirtymäsäännös (transitional provision), 3 mom. (and 4 mom. for family members)
notes: CLOSED PROGRAMME. The repealing instrument is L 57/2011 (given 21 January 2011, in force 1 July 2011) — NOT L 505/2016, which is an unrelated amendment on the income requirement (39, 114, 115 and new 206 a) and says nothing about Ingrian returnees. 57/2011 replaced the whole of Aliens Act s.48, deleting the Finnish-descent remigration limb prospectively and preserving it only under this transitional rule: registration as a returnee at a Finnish mission by 1 July 2011 AND a residence-permit application by 1 July 2016. Both deadlines have passed, so the queue is shut. The 'at least two of four grandparents' formulation is a stated ceiling, hence maximum_degree 2. The quote is the SWEDISH-language text of the Act, because opendata.finlex.fi holds the Finnish original of 57/2011 only as a PDF component; the Finnish text is at https://www.finlex.fi/api/media/statute/98920/mainPdf/main.pdf but that PDF is set in two columns, so pdftotext interleaves the columns and no multi-line Finnish passage can be quoted verbatim from it. Both language versions are authentic under Finnish law.

name: Finland — continuous residence permit for a former Finnish citizen or a person with a Finnish-born-citizen parent or grandparent
origin_test: Applicant is a former Finnish citizen, or at least one parent or one grandparent is or was a Finnish citizen by birth
instrument: Ulkomaalaislaki 301/2004 (Aliens Act), consolidated
quote_original: jos hän on ollut Suomen kansalainen eikä hän ole menettänyt Suomen kansalaisuuttaan kansalaisuuslain (359/2003) 33 a §:n perusteella tai ainakin toinen hänen vanhemmistaan tai yksi hänen isovanhemmistaan on tai on ollut syntyperäinen Suomen kansalainen;
quote_translation: if he or she has been a Finnish citizen and has not lost Finnish citizenship under section 33 a of the Nationality Act (359/2003), or at least one of his or her parents or one of his or her grandparents is or has been a Finnish citizen by birth;
basis: Ulkomaalaislaki 301/2004, 4 luku, 47 § (Jatkuvan oleskeluluvan myöntäminen ulkomailta haettuna), 1 momentti, 1 kohta
notes: origin_based is false: this is descent from a CITIZEN, not membership of a people, so it fails the 'what you ARE' test. Recorded because it is the live successor route by which people of Finnish descent abroad now obtain a continuous residence permit, the Ingrian remigration scheme having shut. The provision closes the list at grandparents, so maximum_degree is 2 on the face of the text. Same open-data source as the s.48 row.

name: Kiribati — right of persons of I-Kiribati descent to enter, reside and become citizens
origin_test: being “a person of I-Kiribati descent”, defined as a person one of whose ancestors was born in Kiribati before 1900
instrument: Constitution of Kiribati (Schedule 2 to the Kiribati Independence Order 1979, SI 1979/719)
quote_original: Every person of I-Kiribati descent shall have an inalienable right to enter and reside in Kiribati and on Independence Day shall, as hereinafter provided, become or have and continue to have thereafter the right to become a citizen of Kiribati.
basis: Constitution of Kiribati s 19, read with the s 29(1)(a) definition
notes: Kiribati has no reachable official online legislation publisher (see prose); the text cited is the Constitution as enacted in Schedule 2 to the UK Order in Council, published by legislation.gov.uk (The National Archives).

name: Kiribati — registration as a citizen at any time for persons of I-Kiribati descent
origin_test: being a person of I-Kiribati descent who did not acquire citizenship on Independence Day
instrument: Constitution of Kiribati (Schedule 2 to the Kiribati Independence Order 1979, SI 1979/719)
quote_original: Every person of I-Kiribati descent who does not become a citizen of Kiribati on Independence Day by virtue of section 20, 21 or 22 of this Constitution shall, at any time thereafter, be entitled upon making application in such manner as may be prescribed to be registered as a citizen of Kiribati.
basis: Constitution of Kiribati s 23
notes: Entitlement, not discretion — “shall … be entitled … to be registered”. No time limit (“at any time thereafter”).

name: Kiribati — definition of “a person of I-Kiribati descent”
origin_test: one ancestor (degree unspecified) born in Kiribati before 1900
instrument: Constitution of Kiribati (Schedule 2 to the Kiribati Independence Order 1979, SI 1979/719)
quote_original: “ a person of I-Kiribati descent ” means a person one of whose ancestors was born in Kiribati before 1900;
basis: Constitution of Kiribati s 29(1)(a)
notes: The only cut-off stated is the ancestor's date of birth (pre-1900), not a degree of removal; “one of whose ancestors” is open as to generation.

name: Kiribati — Banaban status and inalienable right to enter and reside in Banaba
origin_test: being a Banaban: a former indigenous inhabitant of Banaba, or a person one of whose ancestors was born in Kiribati before 1900 who is accepted as a member of the Banaban community in accordance with custom
instrument: Constitution of Kiribati (Schedule 2 to the Kiribati Independence Order 1979, SI 1979/719)
quote_original: “ Banaban ” and “ Banabans ” means the former indigenous inhabitants of Banaba and such other persons one of whose ancestors was born in Kiribati before 1900 as may now or hereafter be accepted as members of the Banaban community in accordance with custom;
basis: Constitution of Kiribati s 125(a); right of entry and residence in s 119(4)
notes: Banaban status is held independently of Kiribati citizenship — most Banabans live on Rabi Island, Fiji. s 119(4): “Every Banaban shall have an inalienable right to enter and reside in Banaba”.

name: Nauru — Nauruan Community membership (Naoero Citizenship Act 2017)
origin_test: membership of the Nauruan Community — persons who are or are deemed aboriginal natives of Nauru by virtue of the institutions, customs and usages of those aboriginal natives, plus defined Pacific Islander limbs
instrument: Naoero Citizenship Act 2017 (Nauru)
quote_original: ‘Nauruan Community’ shall only include: (a) persons who were or were deemed to be aboriginal natives of the Republic by virtue of institutions, customs and usages of the aboriginal natives of the Republic;
basis: s 3 (definition of ‘Nauruan Community’) read with s 4(a) and s 4(e)
notes: Limb (d) of the definition extends membership to persons one or both of whose parents fall within (a)–(c); that is the only degree the Act states.

name: Nauru — admission or recognition as a member of the Nauruan community after 1968
origin_test: admission to, or recognition as a member of, the Nauruan community (indigenous-community membership) after 31 January 1968
instrument: Naoero Citizenship Act 2017 (Nauru)
quote_original: (e) persons who were admitted or recognised as members of the Nauruan community after 31 January 1968;
basis: s 4(e)
notes: This is the open limb: unlike Constitution art 71 it is not closed at a 1968 date.

name: Nauru — Constitution art 71 (Nauruan Community, 1968 cut-off)
origin_test: inclusion on 30 January 1968 in one of the classes constituting the Nauruan Community under the Nauruan Community Ordinance 1956–1966
instrument: Constitution of Nauru 1968
quote_original: Article 71 Members of Nauruan community to be Nauruan citizens A person who on the thirtieth day of January One thousand nine hundred and sixty-eight was included in one of the classes of persons who constituted the Nauruan Community within the meaning of the Nauruan Community Ordinance 1956 – 1966 of Nauru is a Nauruan citizen.
basis: Constitution of Nauru art 71
notes: Closed on its own terms at 30 January 1968; it remains the root of the descent chain in art 72 and Naoero Citizenship Act s 4(a).

name: Niue — statutory definition of “Niuean” (aboriginal race of Niue and descendants)
origin_test: belonging to the aboriginal race of Niue, or being descended from such a person
instrument: Interpretation Act 2004 (Niue), in Niue Laws Volume 2 (2022 consolidation)
quote_original: “Niuean” means a person belonging to the aboriginal race of Niue, and includes a person descended from a Niuean;
basis: Interpretation Act 2004, definition of “Niuean”
notes: Operates through the Land Act 1969 and Niue Act 1966: Niuean land is held by the magafaoa (kin group) and cannot pass outside it. It is not itself a citizenship or residence grant.

name: Fiji — statutory definition of “iTaukei” (aboriginal race indigenous to Fiji)
origin_test: membership of an aboriginal race indigenous to Fiji; or of an aboriginal race indigenous to Melanesia, Micronesia or Polynesia living in Fiji who has elected to live in an iTaukei village
instrument: iTaukei Affairs Act 1944 (Fiji), Cap 120
quote_original: iTaukei includes every member of an aboriginal race indigenous to Fiji and also includes every member of an aboriginal race indigenous to Melanesia, Micronesia or Polynesia living in Fiji who has elected to live in an iTaukei village;
basis: s 2, definition of “iTaukei”
notes: Confers communal status and land rights, not citizenship. The consolidated text is served as JSON by the official laws.gov.fj API; the human-readable page is https://www.laws.gov.fj/ConsolidatedLaw.

name: Fiji — iTaukei land held by iTaukei according to iTaukei custom
origin_test: membership of the iTaukei (indigenous Fijian) people, through the mataqali or other proprietary unit
instrument: iTaukei Lands Act 1905 (Fiji), Cap 133
quote_original: iTaukei lands shall be held by iTaukei according to iTaukei custom as evidenced by usage and tradition.
basis: s 3
notes: Land right, not a status route.

name: Fiji — Rotuman status defined by Rotuman or part-Rotuman descent
origin_test: being a person of Rotuman or part-Rotuman descent; disputes decided by the Council of Rotuma
instrument: Rotuma Lands Act 1959 (Fiji), Cap 138
quote_original: Rotuman means any person of Rotuman or part-Rotuman descent.
basis: s 2, definition of “Rotuman”
notes: “part-Rotuman descent” states no degree of removal; disputed cases are decided by the Council of Rotuma with appeal to the Minister (s 2), i.e. a peoplehood test rather than a generation count.

name: Fiji — Rotuman land inalienable to non-Rotumans
origin_test: Rotuman (or part-Rotuman) descent as the condition of holding registered Rotuman land
instrument: Rotuma Lands Act 1959 (Fiji), Cap 138
quote_original: Land registered under this Act shall not be alienated to non-Rotumans whether by sale, grant, transfer or exchange, provided that nothing in this subsection shall prevent such land being alienated to the State or compulsorily acquired by the State under the State Acquisition of Lands Act 1940 .
notes: Land right, not a status route.

name: Tuvalu — statutory definition of “native” (indigenous inhabitant and descendants)
origin_test: being an indigenous inhabitant of Tuvalu, or a descendant of one, whether wholly or partly of indigenous descent
instrument: Interpretation and General Provisions Act (Tuvalu), Cap 1.23
quote_original: “native” means an indigenous inhabitant of Tuvalu and a descendant of an indigenous inhabitant, whether wholly or partly of indigenous descent; “non-native” means any person other than a native;
basis: definitions of “native” and “non-native”
notes: “whether wholly or partly of indigenous descent” states no fraction or degree; it governs the Native Lands Act, not citizenship.

name: Tuvalu — native land inalienable to non-natives
origin_test: indigenous descent (being a “native”) as the condition of holding native land
instrument: Native Lands Act (Tuvalu), Cap 46.20
quote_original: 5 Restriction of alienation of native land (1) Subject to the provisions of this Act native land shall not be alienated, whether by sale, gift, lease or otherwise, to a person who is not a native.
notes: Land right, not a citizenship or residence route.

name: Sweden — Nordic citizens: citizenship by notification (anmälan)
origin_test: Citizenship of a Nordic agreement state (Denmark, Finland, Iceland, Norway) — a nationality test, not an ethnic-origin test
instrument: Lag (2001:82) om svenskt medborgarskap
quote_original:
En medborgare i en avtalsstat förvärvar svenskt medborgarskap genom anmälan, om han eller hon 
   1. har fyllt arton år, 
   2. har hemvist här i landet sedan fem år, och 
   3. under denna tid inte har dömts till frihetsberövande påföljd.
quote_translation: A citizen of an agreement state acquires Swedish citizenship by notification if he or she 1. has reached eighteen years of age, 2. has been domiciled here in the country for five years, and 3. has not during that time been sentenced to a custodial penalty.
basis: Lag (2001:82) om svenskt medborgarskap, 18 § (read with 16 §, which defines 'avtalsstat' as Denmark, Finland, Iceland or Norway)
notes: origin_based false: 'avtalsstat' is a nationality test (Denmark, Finland, Iceland, Norway), not an ethnic-origin one. Recorded for completeness — no descent-of-a-people limb was found anywhere in Lag (2001:82).

name: Sweden — Nordic agreement states defined (16 §)
origin_test: nationality of Denmark, Finland, Iceland or Norway
instrument: Lag (2001:82) om svenskt medborgarskap
quote_original: Regeringen får, efter avtal med Danmark, Finland, Island eller Norge, meddela föreskrifter om tillämpning av en eller flera av bestämmelserna i 17-19 §§.
quote_translation: The Government may, after agreement with Denmark, Finland, Iceland or Norway, issue regulations on the application of one or more of the provisions in sections 17-19.
basis: Lag (2001:82) om svenskt medborgarskap, 16 §
notes: The definitional hook for the Swedish Nordic limb. Included so the 18 § row has its 'avtalsstat' term sourced.

name: Norway — Nordic citizens: reduced residence for naturalisation
origin_test: citizenship of another Nordic country
instrument: Lov om norsk statsborgerskap (statsborgerloven), LOV-2005-06-10-51
quote_original: For søkere som er statsborger av et annet nordisk land, gjelder ikke vilkårene i § 7 første ledd bokstav d og e. Søkeren må likevel ha oppholdt seg i riket de siste to årene.
quote_translation: For applicants who are citizens of another Nordic country, the conditions in section 7 first paragraph letters d and e do not apply. The applicant must nevertheless have resided in the realm for the last two years.
basis: Statsborgerloven § 13
notes: origin_based false: nationality, not ethnicity.

name: Norway — Nordic citizens: citizenship by notification (melding)
origin_test: citizenship of Denmark, Finland, Iceland or Sweden
instrument: Lov om norsk statsborgerskap (statsborgerloven), LOV-2005-06-10-51
quote_original: Danske, finske, islandske og svenske statsborgere har ved melding rett til å bli norsk statsborger såfremt vedkommende har fylt 18 år, har vært bosatt i riket de siste syv år og i denne tiden ikke er dømt til frihetsstraff eller særreaksjon som følge av straffbart forhold.
quote_translation: Danish, Finnish, Icelandic and Swedish citizens have, by notification, the right to become Norwegian citizens provided that the person has reached 18 years of age, has been resident in the realm for the last seven years and has not during that time been sentenced to imprisonment or a special criminal sanction.
basis: Statsborgerloven § 20
notes: origin_based false: nationality, not ethnicity.

name: Norway — Kola Norwegians (kolanordmenn): descendants of Norwegian emigrants to Murmansk/Arkhangelsk
origin_test: descent from Norwegian citizens who emigrated to Murmansk or Arkhangelsk oblast, Russia, between the second half of the 1800s and the closing of the Russian border in the late 1920s
instrument: Forskrift om erverv og tap av norsk statsborgerskap (statsborgerforskriften), FOR-2006-06-30-756
quote_original: For søker som er etterkommer av norske borgere som utvandret til Murmansk eller Arkhangelsk fylke i Russland fra annen halvdel av 1800-tallet og frem til den russiske grensen ble stengt på slutten av 1920-tallet, og som er innvilget oppholdstillatelse fordi vedkommende har nærmere bestemt tilknytning til Norge, gjelder ikke vilkårene i statsborgerloven § 7 første ledd bokstav d og e.
quote_translation: For an applicant who is a descendant of Norwegian citizens who emigrated to Murmansk or Arkhangelsk province in Russia from the second half of the 1800s until the Russian border was closed at the end of the 1920s, and who has been granted a residence permit because the person has a specified connection to Norway, the conditions in section 7 first paragraph letters d and e of the Citizenship Act do not apply.
basis: Statsborgerforskriften § 8-3 (made under statsborgerloven § 18)
notes: The one genuine Nordic diaspora-origin route found outside Denmark. It sits in the regulation (statsborgerforskriften § 8-3), not the Act, and waives the naturalisation conditions in statsborgerloven § 7(1)(d) and (e) for descendants of the Kola Norwegian emigration. No generational ceiling is stated ('etterkommer av norske borgere som utvandret'), so neither unlimited nor a maximum degree is asserted.

name: Denmark — Danish-minded South Schleswigers resident abroad
origin_test: membership of the Danish national minority in South Schleswig ('dansksindede sydslesvigere')
instrument: Cirkulæreskrivelse nr. 9461 af 17. juni 2021 om naturalisation
quote_original: 5.2. Dansksindede sydslesvigere, der ikke har bopæl i Danmark, kan optages på et lovforslag om indfødsrets meddelelse uafhængigt af ophold her i landet, såfremt ansøgeren opfylder 2 ud af nedenstående 4 kriterier, dog således at kriterium nr. 1 er obligatorisk:
quote_translation: 5.2. Danish-minded South Schleswigers who are not resident in Denmark may be included in a bill on the conferral of citizenship irrespective of residence in this country, provided the applicant meets 2 of the 4 criteria below, on the condition that criterion no. 1 is mandatory:
basis: Cirkulæreskrivelse nr. 9461 af 17/06/2021, bilag 1, pkt. 5.2
notes: The Danish national-minority route: citizenship without any residence in Denmark at all, for members of the Danish minority in South Schleswig. Conferred by individual naturalisation Act, so the circular is the operative instrument.

name: Denmark — Danish descent criterion for South Schleswigers (four generations)
origin_test: Danish descent, defined as at least one person in the applicant's lineage four generations back having held Danish citizenship at birth
instrument: Cirkulæreskrivelse nr. 9461 af 17. juni 2021 om naturalisation
quote_original: 2) Ansøgeren er af dansk afstamning, dvs. mindst én person i ansøgerens slægt fire generationer tilbage har haft dansk indfødsret ved fødslen.
quote_translation: 2) The applicant is of Danish descent, i.e. at least one person in the applicant's lineage four generations back has held Danish citizenship at birth.
basis: Cirkulæreskrivelse nr. 9461 af 17/06/2021, bilag 1, pkt. 5.2, criterion 2
notes: The descent criterion inside the South Schleswig route. 'fire generationer tilbage' is a stated ceiling, hence maximum_degree 4 — one of very few instruments anywhere that fixes a numeric generational limit on an ethnic-origin test.

name: Denmark — Danish-minded South Schleswigers resident in Denmark
origin_test: membership of the Danish national minority in South Schleswig, shown by birth/upbringing in Sydslesvig, Danish schooling and adult attachment to Danish affairs
instrument: Cirkulæreskrivelse nr. 9461 af 17. juni 2021 om naturalisation
quote_original: 5.1. Dansksindede sydslesvigere med bopæl i Danmark kan optages på et lovforslag om indfødsrets meddelelse såfremt: 1) Ansøgeren i en 2-årig periode har opholdt sig i Danmark uafbrudt. 2) Ansøgeren er født eller opvokset i Sydslesvig. 3) Ansøgeren helt eller delvist har gået i dansk skole.
quote_translation: 5.1. Danish-minded South Schleswigers resident in Denmark may be included in a bill on the conferral of citizenship provided that: 1) The applicant has resided in Denmark uninterruptedly for a 2-year period. 2) The applicant was born or raised in South Schleswig. 3) The applicant has attended Danish school wholly or partly.
basis: Cirkulæreskrivelse nr. 9461 af 17/06/2021, bilag 1, pkt. 5.1
notes: The resident counterpart of the abroad limb; the test is birth or upbringing in Sydslesvig plus Danish schooling — cultural belonging rather than a generation count.

name: Denmark — relaxation of residence requirement for former citizens, persons of Danish origin and Danish-minded South Schleswigers
origin_test: Danish origin ('af dansk herkomst') or Danish-minded South Schleswiger status
instrument: Cirkulæreskrivelse nr. 9461 af 17. juni 2021 om naturalisation
quote_original: § 13. For personer, der tidligere har været danske statsborgere eller er af dansk herkomst, samt for dansksindede sydslesvigere kan de almindelige opholdskrav lempes.
quote_translation: Section 13. For persons who have previously been Danish citizens or who are of Danish origin, and for Danish-minded South Schleswigers, the ordinary residence requirements may be relaxed.
basis: Cirkulæreskrivelse nr. 9461 af 17/06/2021, § 13
notes: The enabling clause: 'af dansk herkomst' (of Danish origin) is treated as a category distinct from former citizenship, which is what makes this an origin test rather than a descent-from-citizen test.

name: Denmark — applicants of Danish descent (2 years' residence)
origin_test: one or both parents were Danish citizens at the applicant's birth
instrument: Cirkulæreskrivelse nr. 9461 af 17. juni 2021 om naturalisation
quote_original: Ansøgere af dansk afstamning kan optages på et lovforslag om indfødsrets meddelelse efter 2 års uafbrudt ophold her i landet, når følgende betingelser alle er opfyldt: 1) Den ene af eller begge ansøgerens forældre var danske statsborgere ved fødslen,
quote_translation: Applicants of Danish descent may be included in a bill on the conferral of citizenship after 2 years' uninterrupted residence in this country, when all of the following conditions are met: 1) One or both of the applicant's parents were Danish citizens at birth,
basis: Cirkulæreskrivelse nr. 9461 af 17/06/2021, bilag 1, pkt. 4
notes: origin_based false: 'dansk afstamning' here is defined as one or both parents being Danish citizens at birth — descent from a citizen, one degree, not peoplehood. Recorded alongside the South Schleswig rows to keep the two senses of 'afstamning' in the circular distinguishable.

name: Denmark — Nordic citizens: citizenship by declaration
origin_test: citizenship of Finland, Iceland, Norway or Sweden
instrument: Lov om dansk indfødsret, jf. lovbekendtgørelse nr. 1656 af 23. december 2022
quote_original: § 3. Den, der er statsborger i Finland, Island, Norge eller Sverige og opfylder betingelserne i stk. 2, erhverver dansk indfødsret ved over for Udlændinge- og Integrationsministeriet
quote_translation: Section 3. A person who is a citizen of Finland, Iceland, Norway or Sweden and meets the conditions in subsection 2 acquires Danish citizenship by submitting to the Ministry of Immigration and Integration
basis: Indfødsretsloven § 3
notes: origin_based false: nationality, not ethnicity.

name: Denmark — Nordic citizens: naturalisation after 2 years
origin_test: citizenship of a Nordic country
instrument: Cirkulæreskrivelse nr. 9461 af 17. juni 2021 om naturalisation
quote_original: Stk. 3. Statsborgere fra de nordiske lande kan optages på et lovforslag om indfødsrets meddelelse efter 2 års uafbrudt ophold her i landet.
quote_translation: Subsection 3. Citizens of the Nordic countries may be included in a bill on the conferral of citizenship after 2 years' uninterrupted residence in this country.
basis: Cirkulæreskrivelse nr. 9461 af 17/06/2021, § 7, stk. 3
notes: origin_based false: nationality, not ethnicity.

name: Iceland — Nordic citizens: four years' residence for naturalisation
origin_test: citizenship of one of the Nordic countries
instrument: Lög um íslenskan ríkisborgararétt nr. 100/1952
quote_original: 1. Umsækjandi hafi verið hér búsettur í sjö ár; ríkisborgari í einhverju Norðurlandanna þó einungis í fjögur ár.
quote_translation: 1. The applicant shall have been resident here for seven years; a citizen of one of the Nordic countries, however, only four years.
basis: Lög nr. 100/1952, 8. gr., 1. mgr., 1. tölul.
notes: origin_based false: nationality, not ethnicity. No statutory limb for persons of Icelandic descent abroad was found in Lög nr. 100/1952 — see prose.

name: Iceland — Nordic citizens: citizenship by declaration under Nordic agreement
origin_test: citizenship of a Nordic agreement state (Denmark, Finland, Norway, Sweden)
instrument: Lög um íslenskan ríkisborgararétt nr. 100/1952
quote_original:
B. Ríkisborgari í norrænu samningsríki, sem 
    
 1. hefur öðlast ríkisborgararétt þar með öðrum hætti en með lögum eða samsvarandi hætti,
    
 2. hefur náð 18 ára aldri,
quote_translation: B. A citizen of a Nordic agreement state who 1. has acquired citizenship there otherwise than by statute or an equivalent means, 2. has reached 18 years of age,
basis: Lög nr. 100/1952, 14. gr., B-liður
notes: origin_based false: nationality, not ethnicity.

name: Overseas Korean (F-4) residence status — statutory definition of 외국국적동포
origin_test: A person who formerly held the nationality of the Republic of Korea (including compatriots who emigrated abroad before the establishment of the ROK Government), or a lineal descendant of such a person, who has acquired a foreign nationality
instrument: 재외동포의 출입국과 법적 지위에 관한 법률 (법률 제20677호)
quote_original: 대한민국의 국적을 보유하였던 자(대한민국정부 수립 전에 국외로 이주한 동포를 포함한다) 또는 그 직계비속(直系卑屬)으로서 외국국적을 취득한 자 중 대통령령으로 정하는 자
quote_translation: A person who formerly held the nationality of the Republic of Korea (including compatriots who emigrated abroad before the establishment of the Government of the Republic of Korea), or a lineal descendant thereof, who has acquired a foreign nationality, among those prescribed by Presidential Decree
basis: Act on the Immigration and Legal Status of Overseas Koreans, art. 2(2) (definition of 외국국적동포, foreign-national compatriot); art. 5 (grant of the overseas-Korean status of sojourn, the F-4 visa)
notes: This is a RESIDENCE STATUS, not citizenship: art. 5 empowers the Minister of Justice to grant the 재외동포 status of sojourn (F-4) to a foreign-national compatriot; art. 3 makes the Immigration Act apply otherwise. The statutory limb 직계비속 (lineal descendant) states no generational cutoff, but the class is closed by Presidential Decree — see the separate Decree row. law.go.kr serves its human-readable law pages as a JavaScript shell (lsInfoP.do returns 145 kB of chrome with no article text); the government's own DRF open-API JSON endpoint is the plain-text rendering of the same instrument and is what is cited.

name: Overseas Korean (F-4) — Presidential Decree definition, no generational cutoff
origin_test: Lineal descendant of a person who held ROK nationality by birth (including pre-1948 emigrants) and who has acquired a foreign nationality
instrument: 재외동포의 출입국과 법적 지위에 관한 법률 시행령 (대통령령)
quote_original: 2. 제1호에 해당하는 사람의 직계비속(直系卑屬)으로서 외국국적을 취득한 사람
quote_translation: 2. A person who is a lineal descendant of a person falling under subparagraph 1 and who has acquired a foreign nationality
basis: Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Immigration and Legal Status of Overseas Koreans, art. 3(2) (the 대통령령으로 정하는 자 delegated by art. 2(2) of the Act)
notes: The operative definition. Subparagraph 1 is the person who held ROK nationality by birth; subparagraph 2 opens the class to that person's 직계비속 with NO degree stated — this is the text behind the widely reported 2019 opening of F-4 to 3rd and 4th generation descendants: the Decree closes at no generation at all, so any lineal descendant qualifies. Still a residence status, not nationality.

name: Simplified naturalisation — parent was formerly a national of the Republic of Korea
origin_test: Father or mother was formerly a national of the Republic of Korea
instrument: 국적법 (Nationality Act)
quote_original: 1. 부 또는 모가 대한민국의 국민이었던 사람
quote_translation: 1. A person whose father or mother was formerly a national of the Republic of Korea
basis: Nationality Act art. 6(1)(1): simplified naturalisation — the applicant is exempted from the ordinary five-year domicile requirement of art. 5(1) and needs three years' continuous domicile in Korea
notes: Descent-based, not ethnic-origin based: the test is the parent's former ROK nationality, not membership of the Korean people. Included for completeness alongside the F-4 origin route. The chapeau of art. 6(1) is the exemption from art. 5(1).

name: Special naturalisation — parent is a national of the Republic of Korea
origin_test: Father or mother is currently a national of the Republic of Korea
instrument: 국적법 (Nationality Act)
quote_original: 1. 부 또는 모가 대한민국의 국민인 사람. 다만, 양자로서 대한민국의 「민법」상 성년이 된 후에 입양된 사람은 제외한다.
quote_translation: 1. A person whose father or mother is a national of the Republic of Korea; provided that an adoptee adopted after attaining majority under the Civil Act of the Republic of Korea is excluded
basis: Nationality Act art. 7(1)(1): special naturalisation — no period of domicile is required, only domicile in Korea, and the applicant is exempted from the capacity and livelihood conditions
notes: Descent-based rather than ethnic-origin based. Strongest of the Korean ancestry limbs in terms of conditions waived.

name: Long-Term Resident (定住者) status for nikkei descendants of Japanese nationals
origin_test: Being a nikkei descendant of a person born as the child of a Japanese national (nikkei nisei and sansei)
instrument: 出入国管理及び難民認定法第七条第一項第二号の規定に基づき同法別表第二の定住者の項の下欄に掲げる地位を定める件（平成２年法務省告示第１３２号）
articles: 定住者告示 第三号・第四号; 入管法別表第二「定住者」
quote_original: 該当例としては、第三国定住難民、日系３世、中国残留邦人等。
quote_translation: Examples falling within [this status of residence] are third-country-resettled refugees, third-generation nikkei, Japanese nationals left behind in China, and the like.
basis: Immigration Control and Refugee Recognition Act, Appended Table II, item 'Long-Term Resident', read with the Ministry of Justice Notification No. 132 of 1990 (定住者告示) items 3 and 4, as described on the Immigration Services Agency's official page for the status
notes: THIS IS A RESIDENCE STATUS, NOT CITIZENSHIP — it confers no nationality and no path to it beyond ordinary naturalisation. maximum_degree is expressed as generations of ancestry: 日系3世 counts the emigrant Japanese national as the first generation, so the qualifying ancestor is a GRANDPARENT (degree 2); nisei = parent (degree 1). The closure at the third nikkei generation sits in items 3 and 4 of the 告示 itself (実子 / 実子の実子), but the ISA serves the consolidated 告示 only as a vertically typeset PDF (https://www.moj.go.jp/isa/content/001368764.pdf) which pdftotext -layout cannot linearise — every output line interleaves characters from different vertical columns, so no contiguous phrase of it can be quoted. The ISA's own status page is quoted instead, and it names 日系３世 as the qualifying class. e-Gov 法令検索 does not carry 告示 (a law_title search for 定住者 returns zero).

name: Designated Activities (特定活動) status for fourth-generation nikkei
origin_test: Being a fourth-generation nikkei (日系四世), i.e. a descendant in the fourth generation of an emigrant Japanese national
instrument: 出入国管理及び難民認定法第七条第一項第二号の規定に基づき同法別表第一の五の表の下欄に掲げる活動を定める件（平成２年５月２４日法務省告示第１３１号）— 日系四世の更なる受入制度
articles: 特定活動告示（日系四世）; 入管法別表第一の五の表
quote_original: この制度は、日系四世の方に、日系四世受入れサポーターの方からの支援を受けながら、日本文化を習得する活動等を通じて日本に対する理解や関心を深めてもらい、日本と現地日系社会との架け橋になっていただくことを目的とした制度です。
quote_translation: This system is intended to allow fourth-generation nikkei, with support from a nikkei-yonsei reception supporter, to deepen their understanding of and interest in Japan through activities such as acquiring Japanese culture, and to become a bridge between Japan and the local nikkei community.
basis: Designated Activities Notification (特定活動告示) under Immigration Control Act art. 7(1)(ii) and Appended Table I(5), as published by the Immigration Services Agency in the official '日系四世の更なる受入制度' materials
notes: Introduced 2018 and revised with effect from 2023 (relaxed Japanese-language and age conditions, annual cap 4,000). A RESIDENCE STATUS, and a markedly weaker one than 定住者: maximum five years in total, age 18–35, no family accompaniment, a supporter required, and Japanese-language tests at entry and at renewal. maximum_degree 3 = great-grandparent, since 日系四世 counts the emigrant Japanese national as the first generation. Same PDF problem as the 定住者告示: the consolidated 特定活動告示 (https://www.moj.go.jp/isa/content/001360125.pdf) is vertically typeset and cannot be text-extracted, so the ISA's programme page is cited.

name: Simplified naturalisation — child of a person who was a Japanese national
origin_test: Being the child (excluding an adopted child) of a person who was a Japanese national
instrument: 国籍法（昭和二十五年法律第百四十七号）
quote_original: 一 日本国民であつた者の子（養子を除く。）で引き続き三年以上日本に住所又は居所を有するもの
quote_translation: (i) a child (excluding an adopted child) of a person who was a Japanese national, who has had a domicile or residence in Japan continuously for three years or more
basis: Nationality Act art. 6(i): the Minister of Justice may permit naturalisation without the five-year domicile condition of art. 5(1)(i)
notes: Descent-based, one generation only; there is no ethnic-origin limb in the Japanese Nationality Act. Cited to the e-Gov law-data API because the e-Gov law viewer is a single-page application.

name: Overseas Chinese (華僑) identity certificate obtainable on proof of Chinese descent (華裔證明文件)
origin_test: Being of Chinese descent (華裔), evidenced by a certificate of Chinese descent verified or issued by an ROC overseas mission, in lieu of documentary proof of ROC nationality
instrument: 華僑身分證明條例
articles: 第五條第一項第五款; 第六條; 第三條; 第四條
quote_original: 五、具有我國國籍之證明文件或經駐外使領館、代表處、辦事處、其他外交部授權機構（以下簡稱駐外館處）驗證或出具之華裔證明文件。
quote_translation: (5) Documentary proof of possession of the nationality of our country, OR a certificate of Chinese descent verified or issued by an overseas embassy, consulate, representative office, office or other institution authorised by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
basis: Act Governing the Certification of Overseas Chinese Identity, art. 5(1)(5) — proof of Chinese descent is an alternative to proof of ROC nationality; art. 6 — where the certificate is obtained on the descent limb, the certificate must record that fact and its substantive effect is determined by each competent authority
notes: Not citizenship and not, by itself, a residence permit — the instrument issues an IDENTITY CERTIFICATE (華僑身分證明書, valid one year) and an overseas-residence endorsement in an ROC passport; route_kind is recorded as residence_status only because the schema has no 'status certificate' value. Art. 3 restricts the Act to 僑居國外國民 (nationals residing abroad) and excludes mainland/HK/Macau residents; art. 6 is the tell that the descent limb produces a weaker certificate whose effects each agency decides. The degree of descent required by 華裔 is not stated in the Act — it is left to sub-regulation made by the Overseas Community Affairs Council with the relevant agencies (art. 5(2)), so no degree is recorded here. The 全國法規資料庫 search endpoints 404 to automated fetch; the pcode was located through the Ministry of Justice's own open-data bulk endpoint https://law.moj.gov.tw/api/Ch/Law/JSON, then the quote taken from the served LawAll page.

name: Residence and settlement in Taiwan for Hong Kong and Macau residents
origin_test: Holding permanent residence of Hong Kong or of Macau and not holding travel documents other than those specified (i.e. territorial/national origin in HK or Macau)
instrument: 香港澳門關係條例
quote_original: 香港或澳門居民得申請在臺灣地區居留或定居；其辦法由內政部擬訂，報請行政院核定後發布之。
quote_translation: Residents of Hong Kong or Macau may apply for residence or settlement in the Taiwan Area; the regulations therefor shall be drafted by the Ministry of the Interior and promulgated after approval by the Executive Yuan.
basis: Hong Kong and Macao Relations Act, art. 12 (application for residence or settlement), read with art. 4 (definition of Hong Kong resident and Macau resident by permanent-residence status)
notes: A territorial-origin route rather than a descent route: the qualifying fact is HK/Macau permanent-resident status, not ancestry. 定居 (settlement) leads to household registration in the Taiwan Area and hence to the full exercise of ROC citizenship rights, so this is the strongest of the Taiwanese origin limbs in practice; art. 12 also allows the Executive Yuan to set annual quotas. Art. 4(3) preserves the acquired rights of those who obtained 華僑 status before the British and Portuguese handovers.

name: Accelerated naturalisation — father or mother is or was an ROC national
origin_test: Father or mother is now, or was formerly, a national of the Republic of China
instrument: 國籍法
quote_original: 四、父或母現為或曾為中華民國國民。
quote_translation: (4) the applicant's father or mother is now, or was formerly, a national of the Republic of China.
basis: Nationality Act art. 4(1)(4): naturalisation on three years' lawful residence (183 days a year) instead of the five years required by art. 3(1)(1)
notes: Descent-based, not ethnic-origin based. Note the 'was formerly' limb: a parent who has since lost ROC nationality still qualifies the child. Latest amendment 24 May 2024.

name: Overseas Citizen of India (OCI) Cardholder registration
origin_test: Having been a citizen of India at or after 26 January 1950, having been eligible to become one at the commencement of the Constitution, or having belonged to a territory that became part of India after 15 August 1947 — or being the child, grandchild or great-grandchild of such a person
instrument: The Citizenship Act, 1955 (57 of 1955), as amended by the Citizenship (Amendment) Act, 2015
articles: s. 7A(1)(a)(i)–(iv), 7A(1)(b)–(d), second proviso to s. 7A(1); s. 7B
quote_original: (iii) who is a citizen of another country, but belonged to a territory that became part of India after the 15th day of August, 1947; or (iv) who is a child or a grandchild or a great grandchild of such a citizen; or
basis: Citizenship Act 1955 s. 7A(1)(a)(iii)–(iv): registration as an Overseas Citizen of India Cardholder on the territorial-origin limb and its descendant limb; s. 7B confers the rights attaching to the card
notes: NOT CITIZENSHIP despite the name: s. 7B(2) expressly withholds the rights of a citizen (franchise, public office, constitutional posts); the card is a lifelong multiple-entry visa and residence entitlement. The list of qualifying descendants is CLOSED at great-grandchild, hence maximum_degree 3. The second proviso to s. 7A(1) is a hard national-origin exclusion: nobody whose parents, grandparents or great-grandparents is or had been a citizen of Pakistan or Bangladesh (or another notified country) is eligible. s. 5(1)(g) then converts OCI to citizenship after five years as a cardholder plus twelve months' ordinary residence.

name: Registration as a citizen — person of Indian origin ordinarily resident outside undivided India
origin_test: Being a person of Indian origin, i.e. the applicant or either parent was born in undivided India or in territory that became part of India after 15 August 1947
instrument: The Citizenship Act, 1955 (57 of 1955)
quote_original: (b) a person of Indian origin who is ordinarily resident in any country or place outside undivided India;
basis: Citizenship Act 1955 s. 5(1)(b): the Central Government may, on application, register as a citizen of India a person of Indian origin ordinarily resident outside undivided India; the class is defined by Explanation 2 to s. 5(1)
notes: Full citizenship by registration, with no residence-in-India requirement at all — the applicant must be resident OUTSIDE undivided India. The origin test is set by Explanation 2, whose text at the same source URL reads (verified verbatim at this URL): 'a person shall be deemed to be of Indian origin if he, or either of his parents, was born in undivided India or in such other territory which became part of India after the 15th day of August, 1947.' That closes the class at one generation. Note the different and wider definition used for the Assam provisions in s. 6A(1)(d) ('he, or either of his parents or any of his grandparents was born in undivided India'), which is territory-specific and historical.

name: Accelerated naturalisation for six named communities from Afghanistan, Bangladesh and Pakistan (CAA 2019)
origin_test: Belonging to the Hindu, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, Parsi or Christian community in Afghanistan, Bangladesh or Pakistan (religion plus country of origin)
instrument: The Citizenship Act, 1955, Third Schedule, as amended by the Citizenship (Amendment) Act, 2019 (47 of 2019)
articles: Third Schedule, clause (d), proviso; s. 2(1)(b), proviso; s. 6
quote_original: Provided that for the person belonging to Hindu, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, Parsi or Christian community in Afghanistan, Bangladesh or Pakistan, the aggregate period of residence or service of Government in India as required under this clause shall be read as
basis: Citizenship Act 1955, Third Schedule clause (d) proviso (inserted by Act 47 of 2019, w.e.f. 10 January 2020): the aggregate qualifying period for naturalisation under s. 6 is reduced from eleven years to five years for the named communities from the three named countries
notes: The proviso quoted continues '"not less than five years" in place of "not less than eleven years"' — the closing words were left out of the quote only because they contain typographic quotation marks. The gateway condition is the proviso to s. 2(1)(b), also verified verbatim at this URL: 'any person belonging to Hindu, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, Parsi or Christian community from Afghanistan, Bangladesh or Pakistan, who entered into India on or before the 31st day of December, 2014' and who was exempted under the Passport (Entry into India) Act 1920 or the Foreigners Act 1946 'shall not be treated as illegal migrant for the purposes of this Act'. Operationalised by the Citizenship (Amendment) Rules, 2024. This is the cleanest 'what you ARE' test in the region: it turns purely on community membership and country of origin, with no ancestor and no generation counted.

name: Non-residential Nepali citizenship
origin_test: The person, or their father or mother, grandfather or grandmother, was previously a citizen of Nepal by descent or birth and subsequently acquired foreign citizenship, and the person resides outside the SAARC region
instrument: Constitution of Nepal (2nd amendment, English text published by the Nepal Law Commission)
quote_original: The non-residential citizenship of Nepal may be so granted to a person who has acquired the citizenship of a foreign country, has resided in a country other than a Member State of the South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation, and who or whose father or mother, grandfather or grandmother was previously a citizen of Nepal by decent or birth
basis: Constitution of Nepal art. 14 ('Power to Grant non-resident Nepali Citizenship')
notes: A CONSTRAINED citizenship: the closing words of art. 14 limit the holder to enjoying 'economic, social and cultural rights in accordance with the federal law' — no political rights, no franchise. The ancestral list is closed at grandparent, hence maximum_degree 2. A hard geographic exclusion applies: residence in a SAARC member state (India, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, Bhutan, Maldives, Afghanistan) disqualifies. 'decent' is the official text's spelling of 'descent'. The quote stops before a page break in the PDF. Implementation is through the Nepal Citizenship Act, 2063 as amended in 2079 (2022), whose Nepali text sits at https://lawcommission.gov.np/content/12939/12939-nepal-citizenship-act-2063/ .

name: Registration as a citizen — persons of Indo-Pakistan sub-continent origin resident abroad
origin_test: The person, or their father, or their father's father, was born in the Indo-Pakistan sub-continent, and the person was ordinarily resident outside Bangladesh at the commencement of the Act
instrument: The Citizenship Act, 1951 (Act No. II of 1951), as in force in Bangladesh
quote_original: The Government may, upon application made to it in this behalf, register as a citizen of Bangladesh any person who, or whose father or whose father's father, was born in the Indo-Pakistan sub-continent and who is ordinarily resident in a country outside Bangladesh at the commencement of this Act
basis: Citizenship Act 1951 s. 8 ('Rights of citizenship of certain persons resident abroad')
notes: Full citizenship by registration on a territorial-origin test, closed at the paternal grandfather (agnatic only — 'whose father or whose father's father'). The class is frozen: the applicant must have been ordinarily resident abroad AT THE COMMENCEMENT of the Act (1951), so in practice it is a historic cohort provision rather than a live diaspora route, and it sits alongside s. 3, which deems citizens at commencement anyone 'who or any of whose parents or grandparents was born in the territory now included in Bangladesh'. Pakistan's Citizenship Act 1951 contains a materially identical s. 8, but pakistancode.gov.pk is a JavaScript search front end whose result pages return the homepage, so the Pakistani text is not cited here.

name: Mexico — two-year naturalisation residence for persons originating from a Latin American country or the Iberian Peninsula
origin_test: national/regional origin — being 'originario' of a Latin American country or of the Iberian Peninsula, not current nationality
instrument: Ley de Nacionalidad (DOF 23-01-1998, texto vigente, última reforma DOF 23-04-2012)
quote_original: c) Sea originario de un país latinoamericano o de la Península Ibérica, o
quote_translation: c) Is a native of (originates from) a Latin American country or the Iberian Peninsula, or
basis: Ley de Nacionalidad, art. 20, fr. I(c) (two years' residence instead of the ordinary five under the art. 20 chapeau)
notes: Ordinary requirement in the art. 20 chapeau is five years' residence; fracción I reduces it to two years. The statute says 'sea originario de', an origin test, not 'sea nacional de'. Sourced from the Orden Jurídico Nacional (SEGOB) consolidated PDF because diputados.gob.mx (the usual publisher of CPEUM/LNac PDFs) was unreachable — TCP connect timed out on every attempt from this network. Constitución art. 30 itself contains no origin preference; the preference is statutory. Same fracción I(a) gives the two-year period to a direct-line descendant of a Mexican by birth (the 'lazos consanguíneos' limb), which is a descent test, not an origin-group test.

name: Brazil — one-year residence naturalisation for persons originating from Portuguese-language countries
origin_test: national/linguistic-community origin — 'originários de países de língua portuguesa'
instrument: Constituição da República Federativa do Brasil de 1988
quote_original: a) os que, na forma da lei, adquiram a nacionalidade brasileira, exigidas aos originários de países de língua portuguesa apenas residência por um ano ininterrupto e idoneidade moral;
quote_translation: a) those who, in the manner provided by law, acquire Brazilian nationality, there being required of those originating from Portuguese-language countries only one year of uninterrupted residence and moral fitness;
basis: CF/88 art. 12, II, 'a'
notes: Cited from the Câmara dos Deputados' Legislação Informatizada reproduction of the original 5 October 1988 publication. Art. 12, II, 'a' has never been amended — the planalto.gov.br compiled text shows 'Redação dada' notes on art. 12, I, 'c', on II, 'b' and on §1º (ECR 3/1994, EC 54/2007) but none on II, 'a'. Planalto itself is served as ISO-8859-1 with no declared charset, so accented Portuguese cannot be quote-verified from it; the Senate's art_12 page is a JavaScript shell. Test is origin ('originários de'), not current nationality.

name: Brazil — Migration Act ordinary naturalisation contains no origin ground (statutory context for the constitutional one-year rule)
origin_test: none — recorded only as the statutory context for CF art. 12, II, 'a'
instrument: Lei nº 13.445, de 24 de maio de 2017 (Lei de Migração)
quote_original: Art. 66. O prazo de residência fixado no inciso II do caput do art. 65 será reduzido para, no mínimo, 1 (um) ano se o naturalizando preencher quaisquer das seguintes condições: I - (VETADO); II - ter filho brasileiro; III - ter cônjuge ou companheiro brasileiro e não estar dele separado legalmente ou de fato no momento de concessão da naturalização; IV - (VETADO); V - haver prestado ou poder prestar serviço relevante ao Brasil; ou VI - recomendar-se por sua capacidade profissional, científica ou artística.
quote_translation: Art. 66. The residence period fixed in art. 65(II) shall be reduced to a minimum of 1 (one) year if the applicant meets any of the following conditions: I - (VETOED); II - has a Brazilian child; III - has a Brazilian spouse or partner...; IV - (VETOED); V - has rendered or can render relevant service to Brazil; or VI - is commended by his or her professional, scientific or artistic capacity.
notes: Included because the brief asked about Lei 13.445 art. 66. The enacted text of art. 66 contains NO Portuguese-language-country ground: items I and IV were vetoed. The one-year period for 'originários de países de língua portuguesa' therefore rests directly on CF art. 12, II, 'a', not on art. 66. origin_based is false for this row: it is context, not a route.

name: Colombia — nationality by adoption for Latin Americans and Caribbeans by birth domiciled in Colombia
origin_test: regional origin by birth — 'latinoamericanos y del Caribe por nacimiento', i.e. nationality of origin, not merely current nationality; subject to reciprocity
instrument: Constitución Política de Colombia (1991)
quote_original: b) Los latinoamericanos y del Caribe por nacimiento domiciliados en Colombia, que con autorización del Gobierno y de acuerdo con la ley y el principio de reciprocidad, pidan ser inscritos como colombianos ante la municipalidad donde se establecieren.
quote_translation: b) Latin Americans and Caribbeans by birth domiciled in Colombia who, with the Government's authorisation and in accordance with the law and the principle of reciprocity, request to be registered as Colombians before the municipality where they settle.
basis: CP art. 96(2)(b)
notes: Quoted from the Normograma of the Ministerio de Relaciones Exteriores (cancilleria.gov.co) because suin-juriscol.gov.co would not connect and secretariasenado.gov.co serves ISO-8859-1. 'Por nacimiento' makes this an origin test — a naturalised Argentine, for example, does not qualify. Confers nationality by adoption directly on registration, not an accelerated naturalisation.

name: Colombia — nationality by adoption for members of indigenous peoples sharing border territories
origin_test: indigenous peoplehood — membership of an indigenous people whose territory straddles a Colombian border, subject to reciprocity by treaty
instrument: Constitución Política de Colombia (1991)
quote_original: c) Los miembros de pueblos indígenas que comparten territorios fronterizos, con aplicación del principio de reciprocidad según tratados públicos.
quote_translation: c) Members of indigenous peoples who share border territories, applying the principle of reciprocity in accordance with public treaties.
basis: CP art. 96(2)(c)
notes: A genuine indigenous-status route into citizenship — the direct contrast with US tribal enrollment and Canadian Indian status, neither of which does this. The operative test is membership of the people, not descent from a citizen.

name: Ecuador — Ecuadorian by birth for members of peoples and nationalities present in border zones
origin_test: indigenous peoplehood — belonging to a community, people or nationality recognised by Ecuador with a presence in border zones
instrument: Constitución de la República del Ecuador (2008)
quote_original: 3. Las personas pertenecientes a comunidades, pueblos o nacionalidades reconocidos por el Ecuador con presencia en las zonas de frontera.
quote_translation: 3. Persons belonging to communities, peoples or nationalities recognised by Ecuador with a presence in the border zones.
basis: Constitución art. 7(3)
notes: Stronger than the Colombian analogue: art. 7 is the 'por nacimiento' list, so a qualifying person is Ecuadorian BY BIRTH, not naturalised. Ecuador's 2008 Constitution contains no Latin American / Ibero-American naturalisation preference — art. 8 lists only carta de naturalización, adoption, children of naturalised Ecuadorians, marriage/unión de hecho, and relevant services. That absence is stated here in prose only, not recorded as data.

name: Venezuela — five-year naturalisation residence for persons of Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Latin American or Caribbean nationality of origin
origin_test: nationality OF ORIGIN — the text says 'nacionalidad originaria de', so a naturalised Spaniard or Italian does not qualify
instrument: Constitución de la República Bolivariana de Venezuela
quote_original: El tiempo de residencia se reducirá a cinco años en el caso de aquellos y aquellas que tuvieren la nacionalidad originaria de España, Portugal, Italia, países latinoamericanos y del Caribe.
quote_translation: The residence period shall be reduced to five years in the case of those who hold the nationality of origin of Spain, Portugal, Italy, Latin American countries and the Caribbean.
basis: CRBV art. 33(1), second paragraph
notes: Ordinary requirement in art. 33(1) is ten years' uninterrupted domicile. Explicitly an origin test: 'nacionalidad originaria'. Italy and Portugal appear alongside Spain, so this is not a purely Ibero-American clause.

name: Costa Rica — five-year naturalisation residence for Central American nationals and for Spaniards and Ibero-Americans by birth
origin_test: mixed — 'por nacimiento' (origin) for Spaniards and Ibero-Americans; plain current nationality for 'los nacionales de otros países de Centroamérica'
instrument: Constitución Política de la República de Costa Rica (1949, art. 14 reformed by Ley 7065 of 21 May 1987)
quote_original: 2) Los nacionales de otros países de Centroamérica, los españoles y los iberoamericanos por nacimiento que hayan residido oficialmente en el país durante cinco años como mínimo y que cumplan con los demás requisitos que fije la ley.
quote_translation: 2) Nationals of other Central American countries, Spaniards and Ibero-Americans by birth who have officially resided in the country for at least five years and who meet the other requirements fixed by law.
basis: Constitución art. 14(2)
notes: The 1987 reform replaced the older 'los centroamericanos, españoles e iberoamericanos por nacimiento' formula; inciso 3) gives seven years to Central Americans, Spaniards and Ibero-Americans who are NOT such by birth and to all other foreigners, which is what makes 'por nacimiento' load-bearing. Cited from the Tribunal Supremo de Elecciones' consolidated text: the PGR's SCIJ (pgrweb.go.cr) serves the norm only through a JavaScript shell that returns 200 with no legal text.

name: Panama — naturalisation on reciprocity terms for nationals by birth of Spain or of a Latin American State
origin_test: nationality by birth of Spain or a Latin American State — an origin test, with the substantive conditions set by reciprocity
instrument: Constitución Política de la República de Panamá (texto único, 2004)
quote_original: Los nacionales por nacimiento, de España o de un Estado latinoamericano, si llenan los mismos requisitos que en su país de origen se exigen a los panameños para naturalizarse.
quote_translation: Nationals by birth of Spain or of a Latin American State, if they meet the same requirements that their country of origin demands of Panamanians in order to naturalise.
basis: Constitución art. 10(3)
notes: Ordinary rule in art. 10(1) is five consecutive years' residence. The reciprocity limb means the applicable period is whatever the applicant's own State requires of Panamanians, so no fixed number can be recorded. Published by the Tribunal Electoral, which maintains the official consolidated constitutional text.

name: Honduras — naturalisation after one year for Central Americans by birth
origin_test: origin — 'centroamericanos por nacimiento'
instrument: Constitución de la República de Honduras (Decreto 131 de 1982)
quote_original: 1) Los centroamericanos por nacimiento que tengan un año de residencia en el país;
quote_translation: 1) Central Americans by birth who have one year of residence in the country;
basis: Constitución art. 24(1)
notes: Art. 24(3) requires more than three consecutive years for other foreigners, so the one-year period is the preference. Art. 24(7) requires prior renunciation of the previous nationality in this case, subject to art. 24(8)-(9). Published by the Tribunal Superior de Cuentas.

name: Honduras — naturalisation after two years for Spaniards and Ibero-Americans by birth
origin_test: origin — 'españoles e iberoamericanos por nacimiento'
instrument: Constitución de la República de Honduras (Decreto 131 de 1982)
quote_original: 2) Los españoles e iberoamericanos por nacimiento que tengan dos años consecutivos de residencia en el país.
quote_translation: 2) Spaniards and Ibero-Americans by birth who have two consecutive years of residence in the country.
basis: Constitución art. 24(2)
notes: Two years against the three-plus years art. 24(3) requires of other foreigners.

name: El Salvador — Salvadoran by birth for persons originating from the other States of the Federal Republic of Central America
origin_test: origin — 'los originarios de los demás Estados que constituyeron la República Federal de Centro América'
instrument: Constitución de la República de El Salvador (Decreto nº 38 de 1983)
quote_original: 3º.- Los originarios de los demás Estados que constituyeron la República Federal de Centro América, que teniendo domicilio en El Salvador, manifiesten ante las autoridades competentes su voluntad de ser salvadoreños, sin que se requiera la renuncia a su nacionalidad de origen.
quote_translation: 3º.- Persons originating from the other States that constituted the Federal Republic of Central America who, being domiciled in El Salvador, declare before the competent authorities their wish to be Salvadorans, without renunciation of their nationality of origin being required.
basis: Constitución art. 90(3º)
notes: The strongest form of the pattern: art. 90 is the 'salvadoreños por nacimiento' list, so this is citizenship by birth, not naturalisation, and it turns expressly on origin. No residence period is stated — domicile plus declaration. The historic Federal Republic comprised Guatemala, Honduras, Nicaragua and Costa Rica alongside El Salvador; the instrument does not enumerate them, so no list is recorded here.

name: El Salvador — naturalisation after one year for Spaniards and Hispano-Americans of origin
origin_test: origin — 'españoles e hispanoamericanos de origen'
instrument: Constitución de la República de El Salvador (Decreto nº 38 de 1983)

quote_translation: 1º.- Spaniards and Hispano-Americans of origin who have one year of residence in the country;
basis: Constitución art. 92(1º)
notes: Art. 92(2º) requires five years of 'los extranjeros de cualquier origen', which is the comparator that makes the one-year period a preference.

name: Guatemala — Guatemalan of origin for nationals by birth of the republics that constituted the Federation of Central America
origin_test: origin — nationals BY BIRTH of the republics of the former Central American Federation

quote_original: También se consideran guatemaltecos de origen, a los nacionales por nacimiento, de las repúblicas que constituyeron la Federación de Centroamérica
quote_translation: Guatemalans of origin shall also be deemed to include nationals by birth of the republics that constituted the Federation of Central America
basis: Constitución art. 145 ('Nacionalidad de centroamericanos')
notes: Confers the status of 'guatemalteco DE ORIGEN' — the same class as birth in Guatemala under art. 144 — on domicile plus declaration, and the nationality of origin may be kept. The quote is truncated at 'Federación de Centroamérica' deliberately: the remainder of the sentence in this PDF reads 'y manifestar en ante autoridad competente', a transcription slip for 'manifestaren ante', and I would not reproduce a corrupted clause. congreso.gob.gt sits behind Incapsula and cc.gob.gt, minfin.gob.gt, sat.gob.gt, tse.org.gt and minex.gob.gt all return 403 to non-browser clients; this copy is published by the Ministerio de Gobernación.

name: Argentina — Argentine by birth for persons born in the republics that formed part of the United Provinces of the Río de la Plata
origin_test: territorial/historic-polity origin — birth in a republic that formed part of the United Provinces of the Río de la Plata before its emancipation
instrument: Ley 346 (Ley de Ciudadanía), sanctioned 1 October 1869, texto actualizado
quote_original: 4° Los nacidos en las repúblicas que formaron parte de las Provincias Unidas del Río de la Plata, antes de la emancipación de aquéllas, y que hayan residido en el territorio de la Nación, manifestando su voluntad de serlo.
quote_translation: 4° Those born in the republics that formed part of the United Provinces of the Río de la Plata, before their emancipation, and who have resided in the territory of the Nation, declaring their wish to be so.
notes: Sits in art. 1° ('Son argentinos'), the by-birth list, not in art. 2° (naturalisation), so it is citizenship rather than accelerated naturalisation. No residence period is fixed — the text requires only that the person 'haya residido' in the national territory and declare. Published as the texto actualizado by the Ministerio de Justicia's normativa service. Argentina's naturalisation route in art. 2° is two years' residence for all foreigners regardless of origin.
