name: Latvia — registration as a citizen for Latvians and Livs (valstsnācijas piederīgie / autohtoni)
origin_test: Being a Latvian (member of the state nation) or a Liv (autochthon), evidenced by the applicant's own, a parent's or a grandparent's belonging to that people, plus an ancestor permanently resident in Latvia in 1881 or later
instrument: Pilsonības likums
quote_original: 3) latvietis vai līvs, kurš Latvijā apliecinājis visus šādus nosacījumus: a) ka viņa priekštecis 1881.gadā vai vēlāk pastāvīgi dzīvoja Latvijas teritorijā, kāda tā pastāvēja līdz 1940.gada 17.jūnijam,
quote_translation: 3) a Latvian or a Liv who has established in Latvia all of the following: a) that his or her ancestor permanently resided in 1881 or later in the territory of Latvia as it existed until 17 June 1940,
basis: Pilsonības likums, 2. panta pirmās daļas 3. punkts (with 9. panta trešā daļa allowing dual citizenship for this route)
notes: Registration route, not naturalisation. Sub-point (c) of the same provision requires documentary confirmation 'ka viņš vai vismaz viens no viņa vecākiem vai vecvecākiem ir piederīgs pie valstsnācijas vai autohtoniem' (that he, or at least one of his parents or grandparents, belongs to the state nation or the autochthons), and allows this to be replaced by confirmation of belonging to the Latvian community at the place of residence abroad; sub-point (b) requires Latvian language proficiency. The 1881 residence requirement is a date cutoff, not a generational one, and the law states no maximum number of generations, so unlimited is left false rather than asserted.

name: Lithuania — simplified acquisition of citizenship for persons of Lithuanian descent (lietuvių kilmės asmenys)
origin_test: Being a person of Lithuanian descent: parents or grandparents (or one of them) are or were Lithuanians, and the applicant considers himself Lithuanian and declares this in writing
instrument: Lietuvos Respublikos pilietybės įstatymas (Nr. XI-1196)
quote_original: Lietuvių kilmės asmuo – asmuo, kurio tėvai ar seneliai arba vienas iš tėvų ar senelių yra ar buvo lietuviai ir kuris pats laiko save lietuviu ir deklaruoja tai rašytiniu pareiškimu.
quote_translation: 6. Person of Lithuanian descent — a person whose parents or grandparents, or one of the parents or grandparents, are or were Lithuanians and who himself considers himself a Lithuanian and declares this by a written statement.
basis: Pilietybės įstatymas 2 straipsnio 6 dalis (definition) and 10 straipsnis (right to acquire citizenship under the simplified procedure)
notes: Art. 10(1) verbatim: 'Lietuvių kilmės asmenys, niekada neturėję Lietuvos Respublikos pilietybės, turi teisę supaprastinta tvarka įgyti Lietuvos Respublikos pilietybę, neatsižvelgiant į tai, kokioje valstybėje – Lietuvos Respublikoje ar kitoje valstybėje – jie nuolat gyvena.' — persons of Lithuanian descent who have never held Lithuanian citizenship may acquire it under the simplified procedure regardless of the state in which they permanently reside; art. 10(2) requires that they not be citizens of another state. The definition closes the list of qualifying ancestors at parents and grandparents, hence maximum_degree 2. Art. 12(2) provides for a document confirming Lithuanian descent issued by the Government-authorised institution. The consolidated-text URL carries an edition token (PzzfiKnnlR) which may change when a new consolidated edition is published.

name: Portugal — naturalisation of descendants of Portuguese Sephardic Jews (repealed 2026)
origin_test: Being a descendant of Portuguese Sephardic Jews, shown by a tradition of belonging to a Sephardic community of Portuguese origin evidenced by objective connections to Portugal (surnames, family language, direct or collateral descent)
instrument: Lei n.º 37/81, de 3 de outubro (Lei da Nacionalidade), artigo 6.º, n.º 7, na redação da Lei Orgânica n.º 1/2024, de 5 de março
quote_original: 7 — O Governo pode conceder a nacionalidade por naturalização, com dispensa dos requisitos previstos nas alíneas b) e c) do n.º 1, aos descendentes de judeus sefarditas portugueses que preen- cham cumulativamente os seguintes requisitos: a) Demonstrem a tradição de pertença a uma comunidade sefardita de origem portuguesa, com base em requisitos objetivos comprovados de ligação a Portugal, designadamente apelidos, idioma familiar, descendência direta ou colateral; b) Tenham residido legalmente em território português pelo período de pelo menos três anos, seguidos ou interpolados.
quote_translation: 7 — The Government may grant nationality by naturalisation, waiving the requirements of subparagraphs b) and c) of paragraph 1, to descendants of Portuguese Sephardic Jews who cumulatively meet the following requirements: a) demonstrate the tradition of belonging to a Sephardic community of Portuguese origin, based on proven objective requirements of connection to Portugal, namely surnames, family language, direct or collateral descent; b) have resided legally in Portuguese territory for a period of at least three years, whether consecutive or interpolated.
basis: Lei n.º 37/81, artigo 6.º, n.º 7 (introduced by Lei Orgânica n.º 1/2013, de 29 de julho; tightened by Decreto-Lei n.º 26/2022, de 18 de março, amending the Regulamento da Nacionalidade Portuguesa, and by Lei Orgânica n.º 1/2024, de 5 de março, which added the three-year legal-residence condition); repealed by Lei Orgânica n.º 1/2026, de 18 de maio, artigo 5.º
notes: CLOSED. Lei Orgânica n.º 1/2026, de 18 de maio, artigo 5.º (Norma revogatória) verbatim: 'São revogados os n.os 5, 7 e 13 do artigo 6.º, as alíneas b) e d) do n.º 1 e os n.os 3 e 4 do artigo 9.º, o n.º 4 do artigo 12.º-B, o artigo 13.º e o n.º 4 do artigo 15.º da Lei n.º 37/81, de 3 de outubro.' — paragraphs 5, 7 and 13 of article 6.º of Lei n.º 37/81 are revoked. Article 8.º of that law: 'A presente lei entra em vigor no dia seguinte ao da sua publicação.' (in force 19 May 2026); article 7.º(2) keeps the previous wording applicable to administrative procedures already pending on that date. Source for the repeal: https://files.diariodarepublica.pt/gratuitos/1s/2026/05/09500.pdf (Diário da República, 1.ª série, n.º 95, 18-05-2026).

name: Spain — nationality by carta de naturaleza for Sephardim originating from Spain (programme closed 2019)
origin_test: Being a Sephardi originating from Spain (sefardí originario de España), proved by the evidentiary means listed in art. 1.2, together with a special connection with Spain
instrument: Ley 12/2015, de 24 de junio, en materia de concesión de la nacionalidad española a los sefardíes originarios de España
articles: Artículo 1; Disposición adicional primera; Disposición final sexta
quote_original: se entiende que tales circunstancias concurren en los sefardíes originarios de España que prueben dicha condición y una especial vinculación con España, aun cuando no tengan residencia legal en nuestro país.
quote_translation: ...it is understood that such circumstances are present in Sephardim originating from Spain who prove that condition and a special connection with Spain, even if they do not have legal residence in our country.
basis: Ley 12/2015, artículo 1.1; closing provision: Disposición adicional primera, apartado 1 (three-year application window from entry into force on 1 October 2015, extendable by one year by agreement of the Council of Ministers)
notes: CLOSED to new applications. Disposición adicional primera.1 verbatim: 'Los interesados deben formalizar su solicitud en el plazo de tres años desde la entrada en vigor de la presente Ley. Dicho plazo podrá ser prorrogado por acuerdo del Consejo de Ministros un año más.' The law entered into force on 1 October 2015 (Disposición final sexta), so the three-year window ran to 1 October 2018; the Council of Ministers exercised the one-year extension, closing applications on 1 October 2019. No generational limit was stated; descent was proved through the certificates and evidence listed in art. 1.2, not by counting degrees. Applications lodged before the deadline continued to be processed after it.

name: Spain — two-year reduced residence for naturalisation of Sephardim and of nationals of Ibero-American countries, Andorra, the Philippines, Equatorial Guinea and Portugal
origin_test: Being a sefardí, or a national of origin of an Ibero-American country, Andorra, the Philippines, Equatorial Guinea or Portugal
instrument: Código Civil (Real Decreto de 24 de julio de 1889)
quote_original: Serán suficientes cinco años para los que hayan obtenido la condición de refugiado y dos años cuando se trate de nacionales de origen de países iberoamericanos, Andorra, Filipinas, Guinea Ecuatorial o Portugal o de sefardíes.
quote_translation: Five years shall suffice for those who have obtained refugee status, and two years where the applicant is a national of origin of Ibero-American countries, Andorra, the Philippines, Equatorial Guinea or Portugal, or a Sephardi.
basis: Código Civil, artículo 22.1 (ten years' residence as the rule; two years for the listed categories)
notes: Still in force and open; unlike Ley 12/2015 this route requires legal residence in Spain (two years) and is a reduction of the residence period, not a waiver. The current wording says simply 'o de sefardíes'; the qualifier 'originarios de España' appears in Ley 12/2015 rather than in art. 22.1. The Ibero-American/Andorra/Philippines/Equatorial Guinea/Portugal limb is nationality-of-origin based rather than ethnic, and art. 23 requires renunciation of the previous nationality except for these same countries.

name: Ireland
origin_test: of Irish descent or Irish associations
instrument: Irish Nationality and Citizenship Act 1986 (23/1986), s. 5, substituting s. 16 of the Irish Nationality and Citizenship Act 1956
quote_original: where the applicant is of Irish descent or Irish associations
quote_translation: where the applicant is of Irish descent or Irish associations
basis: Irish Nationality and Citizenship Act 1956, s. 16(1)(a), as substituted by s. 5 of the Irish Nationality and Citizenship Act 1986
notes: Distinct from the Foreign Births Register (s. 7, grandparent-limited). Section 16 is a discretionary WAIVER of the naturalisation conditions, exercised 'in his absolute discretion' — an application still has to be granted, so this is a fast track and not an entitlement. The origin limb states no generation: 'of Irish descent' with no degree, which is why relations records ancestor_unspecified and unlimited stays false. 'Irish associations' was later defined by s. 10 of the Irish Nationality and Citizenship Act 2004 as being 'related by blood, affinity or adoption to ... a person who is an Irish citizen or entitled to be an Irish citizen', again with no degree. Currency confirmed against the Law Reform Commission's revised text of the 1956 Act, which annotates s. 16 as F47 substituted 1.07.1986 with s. 16(2) F49 inserted 1.01.2005; the quote is cited to the amending Act on irishstatutebook.ie, which is the official statute book.

name: Italy

instrument: Legge 8 marzo 2006, n. 124 — Modifiche alla legge 5 febbraio 1992, n. 91, concernenti il riconoscimento della cittadinanza italiana ai connazionali dell'Istria, di Fiume e della Dalmazia e ai loro discendenti

basis: Legge 5 febbraio 1992, n. 91, art. 17-bis(1)(b), inserted by art. 1 of legge 8 marzo 2006, n. 124, published in Gazzetta Ufficiale Serie Generale n. 73 of 28 March 2006
notes: Separate from ordinary Italian jure sanguinis. Limb (a) covers people who were themselves Italian citizens resident in the ceded territories; limb (b) is the origin limb and adds an ethnolinguistic test on top of descent — the applicant must be 'di lingua e cultura italiane' AND a child or direct-line descendant of a limb-(a) person. The descent wording, also verified verbatim at the same source, is 'siano figli o discendenti in linea retta dei soggetti di cui alla lettera a).' — children or direct-line descendants, with no degree stated, hence ancestor_unspecified and unlimited false. Source is the official Gazzetta Ufficiale PDF because gazzettaufficiale.it's HTML views are a single-page-app shell (200 with no legal text) and normattiva.it requires a session cookie, returning HTTP 500 to an unauthenticated fetch — neither can be used as a citable source_url. The GU PDF has a diagonal 'GAZZETTA UFFICIALE TRATTA DA COPIA' watermark interleaved into the extracted text and 2006-era font encoding that mangles accented characters, so the quote is deliberately short and sits inside one line of the pdftotext -layout output.

name: Poland
origin_test: declares membership of the Polish Nation and is of Polish nationality, or at least one parent or grandparent or two great-grandparents were of Polish nationality
instrument: Ustawa z dnia 7 września 2007 r. o Karcie Polaka (tekst jednolity, Dz. U. 2026 poz. 76)
articles: art. 2 ust. 1 pkt 3; art. 2 ust. 1 (opening words)
quote_original: wykaże, że jest narodowości polskiej lub co najmniej jedno z jej rodziców lub dziadków albo dwoje pradziadków było narodowości polskiej
quote_translation: shall show that he or she is of Polish nationality, or that at least one of his or her parents or grandparents, or two great-grandparents, were of Polish nationality
basis: Ustawa o Karcie Polaka, art. 2 ust. 1 pkt 3, consolidated text announced by the Marshal of the Sejm on 21 January 2026, Dz. U. z 2026 r. poz. 76
notes: A separate instrument from the Polish repatriation/origin citizenship route already recorded. The Karta Polaka is an origin status document, not citizenship, hence route_kind residence_status: art. 8a of the same Act builds the procedure around an application for a permanent residence permit made 'z powołaniem się na okoliczność, o której mowa w art. 195 ust. 1 pkt 9 ustawy z dnia 12 grudnia 2013 r. o cudzoziemcach' — the Karta Polaka ground in the Aliens Act — and the card then extinguishes itself at its destination: 'Karta Polaka traci ważność z mocy prawa z dniem wydania dokumentu potwierdzającego nabycie obywatelstwa polskiego albo uzyskania zezwolenia na pobyt stały.' Both passages verified verbatim at the same source. maximum_degree 3 is a ceiling the instrument STATES — the list closes at two great-grandparents and goes no further; it is not inferred from an enumeration that merely stops, because the alternative limb ('jest narodowości polskiej') covers the applicant's own ethnicity and the ancestor list is exhaustive on its face. The opening words, also verified verbatim, are 'Karta Polaka może być przyznana osobie, która deklaruje przynależność do Narodu Polskiego' — the declaration of belonging to the Polish Nation, which is the pure origin test. isap.sejm.gov.pl, the usual Sejm source, is behind an Incapsula bot wall that returns an HTML challenge page with HTTP 200; the act identifier and the current consolidated text reference were resolved through the Sejm's official ELI API (api.sejm.gov.pl/eli/acts/DU/2007/1280) and the text is cited to the official Dziennik Ustaw PDF.

name: Ukraine
origin_test: Ukrainian ethnic origin — the person or their forebears belonging to the Ukrainian nation, or being of origin from Ukraine
instrument: Закон України «Про закордонних українців» від 04.03.2004 № 1582-IV
quote_original: українське етнічне походження - це належність особи або її предків до української нації та визнання нею України батьківщиною свого етнічного походження
quote_translation: Ukrainian ethnic origin is the belonging of the person or of their forebears to the Ukrainian nation and their recognition of Ukraine as the homeland of their ethnic origin
basis: Закон України «Про закордонних українців» № 1582-IV, ст. 1 (визначення термінів), as amended by Law № 4381-VI of 09.02.2012 and Law № 2834-IX of 13.12.2022
notes: A second, distinct Ukrainian origin instrument alongside the citizenship route already recorded. It confers the status of закордонний українець (foreign Ukrainian), not citizenship. The operative benefit, verified verbatim at the same source, is art. 8: 'Закордонний українець може іммігрувати в Україну для постійного проживання за умови отримання в установленому законом порядку дозволу на імміграцію для постійного проживання поза межами квот на імміграцію.' — immigration for permanent residence OUTSIDE the immigration quotas, extended by the same article to the spouse and children. Art. 9 then says holders 'мають право на набуття громадянства України в порядку, встановленому Законом України «Про громадянство України»', which routes back to the citizenship law rather than creating a new citizenship ground. 'предків' (forebears) carries no degree, hence ancestor_unspecified with unlimited false and no maximum_degree — the instrument neither states a ceiling nor states that there is none.

name: Slovakia
origin_test: retains national consciousness and the person or a forebear in the direct line is of Slovak nationality
instrument: Zákon č. 474/2005 Z. z. o Slovákoch žijúcich v zahraničí a o zmene a doplnení niektorých zákonov, v znení zákona č. 364/2022 Z. z.
quote_original: uchováva si národné povedomie, a on alebo jeho predok v priamom rade 3 ) má slovenskú národnosť
quote_translation: retains national consciousness, and he or his forebear in the direct line is of Slovak nationality
basis: Zákon č. 474/2005 Z. z., § 2 písm. a) bod 2, in the consolidated version effective from 1 December 2022
notes: A second Slovak origin instrument, distinct from the origin naturalisation route in zákon NR SR č. 40/1993 Z. z. already recorded. It produces an osvedčenie Slováka žijúceho v zahraničí (certificate of the status of a Slovak living abroad) under § 7, not citizenship, hence residence_status; § 9 ods. 1 písm. c) extinguishes the certificate on grant of permanent residence, and the Act's own footnote 9 cross-refers to § 7 ods. 3 písm. b) of the citizenship act, which is the origin naturalisation limb. 'predok v priamom rade' — forebear in the direct line, no degree stated, so ancestor_unspecified with unlimited false and no ceiling. The '3 )' inside the quote is the statute's footnote marker as it renders in the official text; it is reproduced verbatim because the gate matches literally. slov-lex serves this act only at the 20221201 consolidated snapshot; 2024/2025/2026 snapshot URLs return HTTP 404.

name: Austria
origin_test: descendant in the direct descending line of a person persecuted by the NSDAP or the authorities of the German Reich, or persecuted for supporting the democratic Republic of Austria, who left or was deported abroad
instrument: Staatsbürgerschaftsgesetz 1985 (StbG), BGBl. Nr. 311/1985, in der geltenden Fassung
articles: § 58c Abs. 3 (Abs. 1 and 2 define the qualifying ancestor)
quote_original: dass er Nachkomme in direkter absteigender Linie einer Person ist, die gemäß Abs. 1 oder 2 die Staatsbürgerschaft erworben hat oder erwerben hätte können
quote_translation: that he is a descendant in the direct descending line of a person who acquired, or could have acquired, citizenship under paragraph 1 or 2
basis: Staatsbürgerschaftsgesetz 1985, § 58c Abs. 3, inserted with effect from 1 September 2020 by BGBl. I Nr. 96/2019
notes: RECORDED WITH origin_based FALSE, deliberately. The predicate is persecution and flight, not ethnicity: § 58c Abs. 1 asks whether the ancestor left Austria before 15 May 1955 'weil er Verfolgungen durch Organe der NSDAP oder der Behörden des Deutschen Reiches mit Grund zu befürchten hatte oder erlitten hat oder weil er wegen seines Eintretens für die demokratische Republik Österreich Verfolgungen ausgesetzt war'. In practice the beneficiaries are overwhelmingly Jewish, but the law does not ask what the applicant IS, so it fails the origin test as this atlas defines it and is included here as the closest near-miss worth having on the record. Acquisition is by Anzeige (notification), not discretionary grant, and § 58c Abs. 3 expressly waives the § 10 conditions in respect of the ancestor. 'Nachkomme in direkter absteigender Linie' names no generation; consistent with the treatment of Hungary's 'felmenő', unlimited stays false because the instrument is silent on a ceiling rather than stating there is none. RIS renders each provision twice, once with abbreviations and once expanded ('Paragraph 58 c,'); the quote is taken from the abbreviated rendering.

name: Luxembourg
origin_test: descendant in the direct paternal or maternal line of a Luxembourgish forebear as at 1 January 1900
instrument: Loi du 8 mars 2017 sur la nationalité luxembourgeoise
quote_original: Le descendant en ligne directe paternelle ou maternelle d’un aïeul luxembourgeois à la date du 1 er janvier 1900 et que celui-ci ou l’un de ses descendants a perdu la nationalité luxembourgeoise sur base des dispositions légales antérieures, peut recouvrer la nationalité luxembourgeoise
quote_translation: A descendant in the direct paternal or maternal line of a Luxembourgish forebear as at 1 January 1900, where that forebear or one of their descendants lost Luxembourgish nationality under earlier legal provisions, may recover Luxembourgish nationality
basis: Loi du 8 mars 2017 sur la nationalité luxembourgeoise, art. 89(1), points 1° and 2°
notes: CLOSED PROGRAMME, recorded as a row because it ran, it ended, and its terms are unambiguous. origin_based is FALSE: the test is descent from an ancestor who held Luxembourgish nationality on a fixed historical date, not ethnicity, and it additionally requires that the nationality was LOST under earlier law. Its interest is the reach — 'descendant en ligne directe' with no generation named, anchored to 1 January 1900, so in practice great-great-grandchildren qualified. unlimited stays false all the same: the article names no ceiling but does not state that there is none. The closure is stated in the instrument itself and is verified verbatim at the same source: 'au ministre jusqu’au 31 décembre 2018 ; et 2° de souscrire la déclaration de recouvrement de la nationalité luxembourgeoise devant l’officier de l’état civil jusqu’au 31 décembre 2020. Ces délais sont à observer sous peine d’irrecevabilité de la procédure.' — certification application by 31 December 2018, declaration by 31 December 2020, both on pain of inadmissibility. Both dates have passed, so the route is shut. The '1 er janvier 1900' spacing inside the quote is how the superscript ordinal renders in the official HTML and is reproduced verbatim. Cited to data.legilux.public.lu because legilux.public.lu itself is an Angular shell returning 2.5 kB of chrome for every path; the data host states that the HTML version is identical to the PDF. This is the text as published in 2017, which is the correct version for a provision whose windows have expired.
